aj: quick contract q — planning a tiny SDK lint + docs update. For 429 responses: do we require a `Retry-After` header for all 429s, or only for hard throttles? also: which headers should clients rely on for per-route vs account quotas (X-RateLimit-*/X-Route-Bucket/etc)? trying to avoid churn in the SDK.

maria: short answer: prefer explicit bucket headers where available. `Retry-After` is good but not guaranteed for soft 429s. :eyes:

kevin: fwiw current runtime emits these in most quota-triggered 429s — example: 
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 3
X-RateLimit-Limit: 1000
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Reset: 1710000000
X-Route-Bucket: uploads:v1:123
X-Soft-429: true
```
For soft 429s we add `X-Soft-429: true` and a small JSON body hint with `recommended_wait_ms` when we can. Hard 429s (capacity exhausted) typically have `Retry-After`.

simon: for the SDK we should implement logic: 
1) prefer `X-Route-Bucket` + `X-RateLimit-Remaining/Reset` if present (per-route)
2) else fall back to `Retry-After` header
3) else look for `recommended_wait_ms` in response body
This keeps behavior stable across rollouts and supports soft 429 graceful backoff.

aj: sounds good. one more: are header names stable (case and prefix)? i want to lint the header names in the SDK tests.

maria: yes — `X-RateLimit-*` and `X-Route-Bucket` are stable for now. we may add `X-Burst-Peek` later but will keep backward compat by adding not replacing.

kevin: also note: per-tenant overrides can shadow per-route buckets in rare edge cases (we surface `X-Quota-Scope: tenant|route` when that's happening). SDK should prefer route semantics when `X-Route-Bucket` present, but log telemetry if `X-Quota-Scope` indicates tenant-level enforcement.

aj: perfect — i'll add a lint rule that enforces the SDK test harness to simulate three response shapes: 
- per-route 429 with full X-RateLimit headers and X-Route-Bucket
- soft 429 with `X-Soft-429` + body { "recommended_wait_ms": 1500 }
- hard 429 with `Retry-After` only
and assert the SDK chooses bucket->retry-after->body order.

infra-bot: deploy:eng-platform/servers v2.14.0 rolled out to staging at 2026-03-11T09:12Z :rocket:

simon: one nit — add a test for missing `X-RateLimit-Reset` (sometimes we don't have a precise reset timestamp). SDK should fall back to `now + Retry-After` if reset missing.

aj: good call. will add that. i'll send a PR with test vectors and a short doc blurb. ping me if you want to add examples. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks — will update the API contract doc and let platform know before prod rollout.

kevin: +1. ops: please ensure observability records `quota_scope` and `route_bucket` so we can measure soft vs hard 429 rates.

aj: thanks all — i'll post the PR link when ready.
